files.later_min.fsm:
(?fsm:later_min

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input request)
    (input allow)
    (input datain)
    (input other)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
  )

  (+size
    (request 1)
    (allow 1)
    (datain 3)
    (other 3)
    (seen 3)
    (done 1)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<request
      (-> main_when_1)
    )
  )

  (main_when_1
    (?(<= datain other)
      (=1 (-> main_set_2))
      (=0 (-> main_when_3))
    )
  )

  (main_set_2
    (<- (seen> datain))
    (-> main_when_3)
  )

  (main_when_3
    (?(! (<= datain other))
      (=1 (-> main_set_4))
      (=0 (-> main_done_5))
    )
  )

  (main_set_4
    (<- (seen> other))
    (-> main_done_5)
  )

  (main_done_5
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)

(actor later_min
  (clock clk) (reset (rst_n sync active_low))
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  
  (transaction main (on request) (min seen datain other) (complete done)))
